## load data files

```{r}
# Set Working Directory:
setwd("~/Desktop/Thermal_Tolerance2017/Data/APEX Downloads")

#Load Apex data
Tank1234 <- read.csv("Tank1234.csv", header=T) #load data
Tank1234$Date <- as.Date(Tank1234$Date, format="%d-%m-%y H%:M%")
Tank1234 <- strptime(Tank1234$Date, format="%d/%m/%y %H:%M") #convert date format to characters

Tank5678 <- read.csv("Tank5678.csv", header=T) #load data
Tank5678 <- strptime(Tank5678$Date, format="%m/%d/%y %H:%M") #convert date format to characters

Tank911 <- read.csv("Tank911.csv", header=T) #load data
Tank911 <- strptime(Tank911$Date, format="%m/%d/%y %H:%M") #convert date format to characters


#combine
TData<- merge(Tank1234, Tank5678, by= "Date")

Tdata<-rbind(Tdata, Tank911, by="Date")
```
